subject: Kickstart: MAP bootcamp doc + acceptance decision windows
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickstart: MAP bootcamp doc + acceptance decision windows

Hi Ben, Marissa —

I drafted a compact MAP skeleton for the NovusHealth pilot and a short "decision windows" one-pager we can use in execs' review. Goal: have a co-authored GDoc + slide stub to share with Elaine by EOD tomorrow.

Can you:
- Ben — add the technical validation milestones and dependency list (infra, data access, eval metrics).
- Marissa — add the stakeholder acceptance criteria and proposed demo agenda.

I'll consolidate and run a quick heatmap (risk/impact) on dependencies. I put a rough outline in the linked GDoc below.

Next steps:
1) Everyone add notes to the GDoc (comments ok) by 5/26 12:00pm PT
2) I will merge and share to NovusHealth + propose the 30–45 day decision window

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbootcampMAP

Thanks — kim
--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: MAP bootcamp doc + acceptance decision windows

Thanks Kim — uploaded my section and a simple stakeholder heatmap.

Attachment stubs:
- MAP-bootcamp-template-v1.gdoc (seed doc)
- stakeholder-heatmap.xlsx (heatmap + risk ratings)

Quick notes:
- Technical milestones: sandbox access, inference latency baseline, sample workload (10k messages), perf/day iteration cadence.
- Hard blocker: dataset scrub & VPN access; flagged in the doc as Dependency A.
- Suggest we propose a decision window of 30 days for initial acceptance with a 14-day tech validation runway.

I'll ping infra if we need express VPN setup.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Elaine Martin <elaine.martin@novushealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: MAP bootcamp doc + acceptance decision windows

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — reviewed the seed doc and heatmap. A few quick items from our side:
- Approve 30-day decision window; would like a mid-point check at day 14 with an exec summary.
- We can provide sandbox access for two engineers by next Wednesday (5/31); data scrub owners confirmed.
- Question: can we shorten the tech validation runway to 10 days if we focus on a 1–2 core integration? If so, we'd be comfortable moving faster.

Attachments:
- decision-windows-onepager.pdf

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
Elaine
Director of Digital Ops | NovusHealth
elaine.martin@novushealth.com
(650) 555-0104
